scope: fix: a held direction could step the player off the expected tile in the window between a warp and its mapEnter story
leftover: fieldAction/facility interaction entry via InteractionApplication and fieldAction operation interaction
leftover: stabilize the pre-existing native-ui-regions async click flake

bug.symptom: After adjusting the clock upstairs and walking back downstairs while holding a direction, the player desynced from the tile the return-early interception expects.
bug.cause: mapEnter stories are queued at warp time but only lock input when flushStoryQueue runs; a held direction could take an extra step in between.
bug.fix: StoryApplication.storyMapEntered resolves the mapEnter script immediately and sets mapPending; MovementApplication treats storyPending as paused, and flushes clear it. A map entry without a script does not lock movement.
bug.tests: tests/opening-input-lock.test.js (held input cannot move before a scripted entry takes control; unscripted entries do not lock).

entry.fieldAction: operation { kind: "interaction", id, parameters?, source? } starts a registered session at commit

verification.command: stress: node --test tests/native-ui-regions.test.js x16 concurrent x3 rounds
verification.note: Before the test synchronization, the same stress reproduced 2/48 failures; the test now waits for settle and retries a bounded number of times.
